# Sayerlack

> > Sayerlack, part of The Sherwin-Williams Company, provides industrial wood coating solutions for furniture finishing, outdoor applications, and sustainable surface protection.

Sayerlack specializes in water-based and innovative coating technologies including the Terrae collection, Satin Guard Coatings, and Hydroplus systems. The company serves the wood finishing industry with CATAS-certified premium coating solutions for furniture, wooden windows, and outdoor wood protection.

## Key Topics

- Industrial wood coatings
- Furniture finishing
- Water-based coatings
- Outdoor wood protection
- Sustainable coatings
- Terrae collection
- Satin Guard Coatings
- Hydroplus

- The Sherwin-Williams Company
